lines.text: Last session today, Priya. How's the shoulder since last time?
Since last time I can reach the top cupboard again without wincing.
Fantastic. Let me have a look at the movement.
Go for it, it needs to be working for my sister's wedding in June.
That's full movement overhead and the strength is equal on both sides now.
Note for the scribe, don't put the wedding in the letter.
Keep going with the band rows and the wall slides three times a week for the next couple of months, then once a week is enough to hold on to it.
And if it starts aching again?
Drop back to the gentle range work for a few days, and if it's no better in a fortnight, ring the department and we'll see you without a new referral.
